rows.shows: Deleting training data from the fitted method, 3 seeds, three deletions: one colour value, the red-and-sphere combination, and a random 1 % of items as a control. (a, b) The edited model matches a model refitted from scratch without the data, to within 1e-6. (c) Refusal behaviour, as text. (d, e) Output quality on the surviving corners before against after: red-and-sphere drops it by about 6.3, while the random-1 % control beside it moves it by at most 0.11. That control shows the drop comes from the deleted content, not from refit instability. (f) The edited method minus each rival retrained without the same rows.

rows.shows: Maze task, fraction of held-out multi-way transitions predicted exactly. (a) One row per input setup (seeds 0-2): the CLU against the best comparable rival, with the win, loss or comparable label.
